title: Lash Photo Studio
summary: A phone website for a lash or beauty artist: send a client's lash photo, pick a look, and a minute later get an Instagram-ready shot. No OpenAI API bill, because a Mac at home does the edit with Codex on your normal ChatGPT plan. The lash work itself is kept exactly as it is.
how_to_use: Give the folder to Claude and say: 'Set this up for me: deploy the website to my Cloudflare account and run the agent on my Mac with my ChatGPT Codex login. Rebrand it for my business.'
requires: A Mac that stays on, a ChatGPT plan with Codex, a free Cloudflare account, Node and Python 3.
